summary: Re-tested sticky category nav after removing md:flex-1 in favor of md:flex-wrap md:justify-center. All 7 requested checks PASS. No chip overlaps at any viewport, symmetric gaps on desktop 1440, clean centered wrap on tablet 900, horizontal scroll functional on mobile 375, scrollspy click+scroll works, and regressions (tacos builder card, absent legacy CTA banner, ScrollToTop on route entry) all clean.
critical_code_review_comments: Menu.jsx line 122: clean, minimal solution — natural chip widths + justify-center + flex-wrap on md+ is the correct approach. No wasted-space feel; centered layout is intentional.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sticky nav is stable. Container classes: `flex gap-1.5 sm:gap-2 overflow-x-auto md:overflow-visible md:flex-wrap md:justify-center py-2.5 md:py-3 no-scrollbar`. Measured layout: Desktop 1440 -> 9 chips single row, leftGap=124.2px, rightGap=124.2px (symmetric), 0 overlaps, flex-wrap=wrap, overflow-x=visible. Tablet 900 -> chips wrap to 2 centered rows (7 chips row1: signatures→menu-kids, 2 chips row2: desserts+boissons), 0 overlaps, both rows centered. Mobile 375 -> flex-wrap=nowrap, overflow-x=auto, scrollWidth=948 > clientWidth=351 (swipeable). Scrollspy: click cat-wraps -> active=true immediately, section-wraps top=160px (in 0-300 range). Scroll to section-drinks -> cat-drinks becomes active. Regressions: menu-item-tacos-builder present, build-burger-cta banner absent, scrollY=0 after nav to /menu. Prod (burgertimes.fr) not tested per instructions.
